answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 31 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The wharf register is checked at draw time, crystal lists the eligible set, and reef seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 31 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Collateral of 95 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
